name: top-github-users-ranking-action
description: Generate country GitHub user rankings, SVG badges and copyable tables, then commit the results.

scripts.prepare: node -e "import('node:fs').then(fs => fs.rmSync('dist', { recursive: true, force: true }))" && rollup src/index.js --file dist/index.cjs --format cjs --sourcemap -p commonjs -p node-resolve
scripts.all: npm run lint && npm run prepare && npm run test

author: Gayan Kuruppu
